case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining the cost movements behind it. We recognise those cost pressures, while our analysis supports a lower price tied to a longer agreement.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

A longer agreement would give you more predictable demand while keeping the renewal straightforward to administer. We are flexible on payment terms; Option B retains your proposed payment terms, so please tell us which package works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to agreeing a practical renewal that supports continued supply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. We are unable to meet the significantly lower price points you proposed, as our pricing already reflects a very tight calculation.

However, as we value our business relationship, our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We appreciate your feedback and are agreeable to extending the contract to 24 months while maintaining the 30-day payment terms. This longer commitment allows us to offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €4.88 per unit. Another option is a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for improving your price and offering a longer agreement. We acknowledge your tight pricing calculation and understand that the verified demand change does not alter it.

We are making a modest adjustment to our package and ask for further price movement in return, supported by a longer commitment that keeps administration straightforward. We are flexible on contract length; please tell us which option works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.47 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.47 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net.

We appreciate our continued relationship and would be glad to keep this renewal light on moving parts.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your preference for a 24-month agreement with 45-day payment terms. However, our pricing calculation remains very tight, and we cannot meet the significantly lower price points you proposed.

We are delighted to continue working with you and supporting your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable service. We are pleased to present our updated offer to keep our valued partnership strong. We can propose a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal suits your requirements and look forward to your positive feedback.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for the further price adjustment and for retaining our preferred payment terms and contract length. We recognise that your pricing leaves limited room and that you cannot accept the lower prices we proposed.

We are taking a modest step on price and ask for a further step from you in return for a predictable agreement with little administration. We are flexible on contract length; please tell us which option works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.53 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.53 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net.

We value working with you and hope to keep this renewal a short story rather than a saga.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued interest and your modest step on price. As a valued customer, we always strive to support you with our extensive stock and dependable service. 

Maintaining the 24-month agreement and 45-day payment terms, we can make a slight adjustment to €4.89 per unit. To summarize, our Angebot stands at a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

This reflects the absolute limits of our current pricing structure. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Kindly note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
